source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #3-06: Struck by Shadows

items.name: Shadow Blend
items.text: The umbral drake's form shifts and blends reflexively with surrounding shadows. It gains an additional reaction each round, but it can use this reaction only for Shadow Evade.

items.name: Shadow Evade
items.text:
Trigger A creature attacks the umbral drake while it is in an area of dim light

---

Effect The umbral drake further obscures its position. The attacker must succeed at a DC 11 Flat check check in order to affect the umbral drake, as if the drake were Hidden for the triggering attack.

items.name: Draconic Frenzy
items.text: The umbral drake makes one bite Strike and two tail Strikes in any order.

items.name: Shadow Breath
items.text:
An umbral drake spits a ball of black liquid that explodes into a cloud of frigid black shadow. This attack has a range of 40 feet and explodes in a 5-foot-radius burst. Creatures within the burst take 4d6 cold damage (DC 20 basic Reflex save save). The explosion of shadow also snuffs out mundane light sources the size of a torch, lantern, or smaller, and attempts to counteract magical light with a +12 counteract modifier.

The umbral drake can't use Shadow Breath again for 1d6 rounds.

items.name: Speed Surge
items.text:
Frequency three times per day

---

Effect The umbral drake Strides or Flies twice.
